record_scope_reconstruction: Mozambique closure of the Goba road port caused closure of paired Mhlumeni; essential traffic diverted to Lomahasha, which remained operational.

source_checks.finding: Official April6 statement explicitly says consequential closure as of Friday April3; Lomahasha stays open.
